description: This file defines a final class 'TracingTags' that provides key constants for adding standardized tags to tracing spans within the Eclipse Ditto project. The constants include tags related to AMQP commands, HTTP requests, authentication, mappings, and acknowledgements, all prefixed with 'ditto.'. The class is designed to serve as a utility for consistent tagging.

classes.name: TracingTags
classes.description: A utility class providing defined constants for trace tags related to various aspects of the Eclipse Ditto service such as AMQP, HTTP, authentication, mapping, and acknowledgement.

methods.name: TracingTags()
methods.description: Private constructor that throws AssertionError to prevent instantiation, indicating this class should only be used as a static utility holder.
